verdict.rationale: Docs walk through creating a collection, adding documents, searching, filtering, and faceting in a single quickstart guide, and a runtime probe confirms a real local install (via Homebrew) with no account needed, followed by an actual index+search roundtrip completing in under a second with typo-tolerant matching. This directly demonstrates the create-index/add-docs/search flow works quickly and independently of the docs' own claims. Missing for 10: an independent/community account specifically praising the quickstart's speed or ease (comments focus on other aspects like memory use and feature comparisons rather than the onboarding experience itself).
